confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Doha pricing; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and licensed-venue anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel anchors are least certain because Doha has few registered hostels, and the 1-star and 3-star hotel anchors are also uncertain. July is low season, so accommodation anchors reflect summer discounting. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are based on general licensed-venue price levels, with cocktail and wine set relative to beer. FX: the 0.6955 figure came from a search snippet of the RBA homepage, not a verified read of the RBA table. A third-party site reported 0.6947 for 16 October, but the RBA's 16 October figure may not be published yet at generation time.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Gulf cities such as Dubai and Abu Dhabi, adjusted for Doha's thinner budget-accommodation supply, high alcohol prices in licensed hotel and restaurant venues, and summer off-season hotel rates.
